title: Resident Cost-Sharing Schedule — Outpatient and Part B Therapy Services
content:
This schedule sets out, tier by tier, the cost-sharing figures the central business office applies to a resident's share of **Outpatient and Part B Therapy Services** visits: the Part B coinsurance percent, the deductible that applies, how a Medicare Advantage copay is set, the Medical Assistance resident copay, and the rounding of resident charges.

## Schedule

| Tier | Part B coinsurance (resident share of the Part B allowed amount after the deductible) | Medicare Advantage visit copay basis | Medical Assistance resident copay per visit | Annual Part B deductible that applies | Rounding of resident charges |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Medicare Part B Physical Therapy Plan of Care | 20 percent | Not applicable | $0.00 | The shared Part B deductible | Half up to the cent, per charge row |
| Medicare Part B Occupational Therapy Plan of Care | 20 percent | Not applicable | $0.00 | The shared Part B deductible | Half up to the cent, per charge row |
| Medicare Part B Speech-Language Pathology Plan of Care | 20 percent | Not applicable | $0.00 | The shared Part B deductible | Half up to the cent, per charge row |
| Medicare Advantage Outpatient Therapy Plan of Care | 0 percent | The per-visit copay recorded from the plan's authorization | $0.00 | The shared Part B deductible | Half up to the cent, per charge row |
| Medical Assistance Therapy Plan of Care | 0 percent | Not applicable | $0.00 | The shared Part B deductible | Half up to the cent, per charge row |
| Private Pay Therapy Plan of Care | 0 percent | Not applicable | $0.00 | The shared Part B deductible | Half up to the cent, per charge row |

## Notes to the schedule

1. **Part B coinsurance percent.** The coinsurance percent is the resident's share of the Part B allowed amount after the deductible. It is 0 where Part B is not the payer.
2. **The shared Part B deductible.** The annual Part B deductible that applies is the one deductible of the ancillary services charter (Ancillary and Optional Services Billing), met across all Part B services at the center. Outpatient and Part B Therapy Services keeps no separate therapy deductible.
3. **Medicare Advantage copay.** For the Medicare Advantage Outpatient Therapy Plan of Care, the copay per visit is not a fixed schedule figure: it is the per-visit copay recorded from the plan's authorization. No other tier has a Medicare Advantage copay.
4. **Medical Assistance resident copay.** The copay charged to a nursing facility resident on Medical Assistance is $0.00 per visit; institutionalized residents pay none.
5. **Rounding.** Every resident therapy charge is rounded half up to the cent, row by row: each charge row is rounded on its own.

## Reading the schedule (hypothetical figures)

- A Medicare Advantage plan's authorization recorded a copay of $17.40 per visit: under this schedule that recorded figure is the visit copay basis for that plan.
- A resident share worked out to $9.835 before rounding: rounded half up to the cent it is $9.84; a share of $9.8349 rounds to $9.83.
